entities.summary: Éliane Louise Thérèse Radigue was a French composer. She began working in the 1950s and her first compositions were presented in the late 1960s. Until 2000 her work was almost exclusively created with the ARP 2500 modular synthesizer and tape. Beginning in 2001 she composed mainly for acoustic instruments.

entities.summary: Éliane Louise Thérèse Radigue was a French composer. She began working in the 1950s and her first compositions were presented in the late 1960s. Until 2000 her work was almost exclusively created with the ARP 2500 modular synthesizer and tape. Beginning in 2001 she composed mainly for acoustic instruments.
